_meta.method: Official firm domains only (help centers / rule pages) queried through a web-search engine restricted to the firm's domain. Direct page fetches (WebFetch/curl) were blocked by the research environment's network policy, so every value comes from search extracts of the official pages. Third-party blogs were used only to detect conflicts, never as the source of a value.

status_legend.VERIFIED: Stated on the firm's official domain (help center / rules page).
status_legend.UNCERTAIN: Official sources conflict, are dated, or differ by product variant; conflict recorded.
status_legend.NOT_FOUND: No official statement located. Never assumed.

_meta.selection_rationale: Topstep explicitly permits automated strategies (TopstepX/ProjectX API) subject to platform rules; Apex's current rules prohibit all automation (rejected as a target for a systematic bot); FTMO permits EAs and is the spot-FX/CFD target. MyFundedFutures / Take Profit Trader automation policies could not be verified -> secondary only.

evaluation_cost.value: $49/month Standard path ($95/month No-Activation-Fee path); reset = monthly price
evaluation_cost.conflict: Marketing pages show $85/mo for NAF 50K; help-center table used.

activation_fee.value: $149 one-time per XFA on Standard path

profit_target.conflict: Topstep Labs 'Phase 1'/static products list $4,000; standard 50K Combine lists $3,000.

daily_loss_limit.mode: optional at checkout; triggering pauses trading for the session (not a fail)

consistency.value: Best day must be <= 55% of total profit; otherwise target rises to best_day/0.55 (not a failure)
consistency.conflict: Some official text phrases it as 55% of the Profit Target; older pages 50%. Simulator uses the stricter best_day <= 0.55 * total profit at pass time.

minimum_trading_days.value: NOT_FOUND as a fixed number; consistency target implies >= 2 days

maximum_trading_days.note: Stated by multiple sources; subscription bills monthly.

trading_hours.value: Trading day 5:00 PM CT -> 3:10 PM CT; must be flat by 3:10 PM CT; risk desk starts flattening at 3:08 PM CT

overnight.value: Not allowed past 3:10 PM CT (day-trading only). Holding from 5 PM CT reopen to next-day session is inside one trading day.

holidays.value: Close 15 minutes before any early close

news.value: No requirement to flatten for economic releases; prohibited to trade full max position size directly into scheduled major news

automation.value: Allowed (incl. custom bots via TopstepX/ProjectX API); no HFT; no exceptions for bot malfunctions

prohibited.value: Account stacking; software/AI/ultra-high-speed systems giving unfair advantage; orders outside best bid/offer; exploiting SIM fills; cross-account hedging; coordinated trading; VPNs; holding within 2% of price limit

payout.value: XFA: Standard path no consistency requirement; Consistency path 40%

fx_availability.value: CME FX futures (6E, 6B, 6J, ...); no spot FX

consistency.value: None in evaluation; 50% for payouts (new), 30% legacy

minimum_trading_days.value: Conflict: none (intraday page) vs 7 (evaluation rules page)
